title: Prices first
problem: Every market-relative claim is blocked by a missing price feed (Q-101). Without it we cannot compute vig, fair value, CLV or edge.
proposal: License one point-in-time price archive and replay a completed season before any strategy runs
question: RA-13
audit: Adopt only after the licence is signed; highest impact item on the board

title: Store every injury filing, not the latest
problem: The stored table lags the official Thursday filing by one filing and silently drops two clubs
proposal: Scrape the hub on a fixed schedule, keep every filing with its timestamp, and never overwrite
question: RA-01, RA-02
audit: Adopt; this is the single highest-value fix to existing data

title: Freeze the luck-filter thresholds in advance
problem: A filter set chosen after seeing results is not a filter
proposal: Write the four filters and their thresholds into a versioned file; any change becomes a new version
question: A-01..A-05
audit: Adopt now; costs nothing and prevents later self-deception

title: Pre-register every strategy before it is scored
problem: A strategy described after its results is a story, not a test
proposal: Each entry gets a locked record: rule, stake, market, sample target, and the date it was locked
question: RA-13
audit: Adopt now

title: License participation data
problem: Replacement cost in points cannot be estimated from box scores
proposal: License snap counts and routes; measure the point value of losing a starter by position
question: RA-03
audit: Owner decision on cost; without it the depth model stops at counting bodies

title: Use realised snap share, not club charts, as the depth truth
problem: All three club charts inspected are explicitly unofficial
proposal: Once participation is licensed, rank depth by realised snap share and keep club charts as a prior
question: RA-09, RA-17
audit: Adopt after S-105; publish both so the difference is visible

title: Three-state game status
problem: A blank status is not 'probable'; it is 'not yet filed'
proposal: Encode out / designated / not-yet-filed as three states and never collapse them
question: RA-18
audit: Adopt now

title: Adopt one venue's settlement rulebook
problem: A record is undefined until pushes, ties and voids are defined
proposal: Pick one venue, store its published rulebook version, settle every strategy against it
question: A-04
audit: Adopt now; needed before any graded record exists

title: Publish home-field as an interval or not at all
problem: 2026 shows +0.50 points over 129 games; the fit shows +0.09. Both are noise at this n
proposal: Either pool multiple seasons or set home field to zero in published lines
question: A-01, A-02
audit: Adopt: zero is more honest than a one-season estimate

title: Estimate correlation only where joint data exists
problem: Only the game-level margin/total pair is measurable today (r = -0.161, n = 136)
proposal: Publish measured pairs; leave prop and SGP cells blank with the reason
question: A-09, A-10
audit: Adopt; already implemented on the line lab page

title: Define the reward schedule before the first entry
problem: An unrewarded leaderboard selects for nothing
proposal: Owner writes budget, payout tiers, eligibility and anti-gaming rules
question: RA-14
audit: Owner decision

title: One owner per published number
problem: Five dashboards publish overlapping claims
proposal: Publish a metric ownership table; other pages link instead of restating
question: RA-14
audit: Adopt; this dashboard follows the rule by linking, not restating

title: Score lines against outcomes now, the market later
problem: Waiting for a price feed blocks all validation
proposal: Score our own lines against realised results immediately; add CLV when prices exist
question: RA-16
audit: Adopt; live on the line lab page

title: Record a licence position per source
problem: Storing league pages long-term has no stated legal basis in the repo
proposal: One line per source: public page, licence, or fair-use note
question: RA-13
audit: Adopt

title: Price two prop markets, not ten
problem: Prop modelling without settlement rules produces unscoreable output
proposal: Pick two markets, write their settlement rules, model only those
question: RA-13
audit: Adopt after S-108

title: Make the whole site one dashboard with a stable layout
problem: Nine published trees make the project harder to navigate than the data warrants
proposal: Keep one landing page with category navigation and link the archives as archives
question: RA-14
audit: Recommended; this session's s92 tree is built that way

title: Show the evidence for every number on the same row
problem: A number without its source cannot be checked without leaving the page
proposal: Every table row carries a source link and a verification status
question: RA-05
audit: Adopted in this build

title: Label stale data instead of refreshing it silently
problem: Silent refresh destroys the audit trail and makes past pages unreproducible
proposal: Freeze each dataset by filing date and show a staleness badge
question: RA-12
audit: Adopted in this build

title: Add a coverage column to every league-wide claim
problem: 3 of 32 depth charts were inspected, but the page could imply 32
proposal: Every league-wide table states inspected/total with the shortfall named
question: RA-17
audit: Adopt

title: Write the missing-information discovery plan before the roadmap
problem: Decisions cannot be scheduled while the missing inputs are unnamed
proposal: The information-have/lack register is the roadmap's input, not its appendix
question: RA-13
audit: Adopted in this build
